description: This source file provides decorators, context managers, and utility functions for controlling the behavior of TorchDynamo during compilation, including enabling/disabling tracing, handling graph breaks, setting execution stances, and inlining or excluding functions from the graph. It also manages configuration patches and provides mechanisms for marking tensors with dynamic, static, or unbacked dimensions, as well as integrating external modules like einops.

classes.name: set_stance
classes.description: Decorator and context manager for setting the current execution stance of the TorchDynamo compiler, supporting context management and function wrapping with enforced stance settings.

classes.name: DynamoConfigPatchProxy
classes.description: Proxy class for torch._dynamo.config patches, enabling traceable configuration modifications during TorchDynamo's tracing process.

classes.name: _DimRange
classes.description: Data class representing a tensor dimension with associated minimum and maximum size bounds, used in marking dynamic tensor dimensions.
